Paragraph: Hearing all those words said by Hanuma, the illustrious Rama, well pleased in his face, spoke to his brother Lakshmana standing at his side.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama processes Hanuman's speech and reacts with visible pleasure, then turns to consult his brother.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama shows positive emotional response and engages his trusted brother in dialogue rather than acting unilaterally.
Outcome/Resolution: Sets up Rama's analytical assessment of Hanuman shared with Lakshmana.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rama's consultation with Lakshmana reflects sahodara-bhava, the ideal of trusting fraternal bond.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Shows healthy relational functioning - sharing significant decisions with a trusted family member rather than isolating oneself.
